https://mastodon.social/@Cambion@mastodo.text: I've been really enjoying #PlanetZoo2 🐯! Perfect release date, right at the start of my pregnancy leave 😏. It runs great on the Steam Deck. Controls are surprisingly complete for controllers and performance is good even after upping the graphics. Only bug I've had so far was ringtail lemurs launching themselves out of their habitat 🚀. Which was a bit frustrating but also kinda funny. It that got fixed in today's patch luckily. Now they behave like animals again, instead of rockets 😅. #steamdeck #gaming #gamingonlinux #linuxgaming #planetzoo #zootycoon
